snippet: NullBrowser blocks screenshots, clears session data, and avoids keeping browser history.

snippet: Harsha Search is the local instant-answer index built into NullBrowser, with web fallback when no local result exists.
Downloads are confirmed before starting and handled through Android Download Manager.
Settings include Strict Mode for disabling JavaScript and Lite Mode for blocking page images.
Stats show pages loaded, trackers blocked, downloads started, and active privacy toggles.
The secure vault stores bookmarks locally and can be cleared from inside the app.
The VPN button prepares Android VpnService, but a real provider or tunnel backend is still required.
The tracker engine loads a domain dataset from app assets and blocks matching requests.
Panic wipe clears cookies, cache, WebView storage, form data, and local privacy state.
NullBrowser policy: no browsing history database, secure screen, session cleanup, and transparent download limits.
